description: This file defines the `HttpService` class, which provides wrapper methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to a backend API, handling serialization/deserialization of JSON data, error handling, and user notifications via a toast service.

classes.name: HttpService
classes.description: A service class to facilitate HTTP communication with backend APIs, supporting GET, POST, PUT, DELETE operations with JSON serialization and error handling.

methods.name: HttpService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the HttpService with an HttpClient, configuration options, and a toast service.

methods.name: HttpGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request for a specified resource and deserializes the response into the specified type.

methods.name: HttpDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request for a specific resource identified by ID and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with data payload serialized as JSON, handles errors by showing toast notifications, and deserializes the response.

methods.name: HttpPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request with data payload serialized as JSON, displays error toast on failure, and deserializes the response.

methods.name: ToJson
methods.description: Helper method to serialize an object into JSON format suitable for HTTP content.

methods.name: FromHttpResponseMessage
methods.description: Helper method to deserialize the content of an HTTP response message into a specified type.
